bullet_point: [Quality Premium Stockfish Dry Cod, Already Cut You do not Need to Worry About Paying to Cut. Very Nice for all Nigerian & Other African Food., Direct from Norway, Pack Weight 14 oz (400g), Number in a Pack may Varies Due to Cut Size]
description:
Odeefoods sells quality Norwegian COD Stockfish at affordable price.

Stockfish is a world class delicacy in many part of the world, for example Nigeria, Italy, Portugal, Norway etc.

Our Stockfish is produced in Norway.

Processing stages The climate in Northern Norway is perfect for creating Stockfish - with temperatures of around 0°C and just the right balance of wind, sun and rain. It is not SMOKED. A slight change in weather conditions can affect the product, which is why only Stockfish from Norway tastes perfect - mild and with a firm texture that holds even after soaking.

Stage One - Preparing
The cod is dried on large open-air timber racks, which we call "Stocks" - hence the name "Stockfish"

Stage Two - Fresh Air
Stockfish from Norway is processed by nature itself. Between the months of February and May, Northern Norway has the best climate in the world to dry this type of fish

Stage Three - Maturation
After around three months outside in open air, we move the Stockfish inside to mature. It’s left in this dry and airy environment for up to 12 months. Just as with wine, each year has its own unique taste and flavour.

Stage Four - Sorting
Sorting the fish might not seem like an important job, but it requires skills that are acquired over many years. The grading experts are able to quickly sort the Stockfish according to size, quality, thickness and even aroma. In fact, there are more than 20 different classifications of Stockfish

No Preservatives or Salt is added to the Stockfish while processing.

bullet_point: [Superior Flavor: Better Tasting Than Ordinary Canned Tuna - Healthy, Gluten Free, Sushi-Grade Tuna, Sustainably Sourced: U.S. Troll Caught (No By-Catch), Harvested Responsibly, Health Benefits: Our Albacore Forage in the Colder Pacific NW Waters and Have a Higher Amount of Omega-3 Oils (Plus Complimentary Premium Basil Sample Pack), Thoughtfully Processed: Wild Caught, U.S. Hand Packed, BPA-Free Pull-Tab Cans, 100% Sustainable, Dolphin Free, Certified & Best Choice: MSC Certified and Best Choice on Monterey Bay Seafood Watch Program]
description:
HEALTH BENEFITS

Why does our canned Albacore taste different than industrial tuna?

It’s different fish. Our Albacore are young, fatty fish individually line-caught in the cold waters of the North and South Pacific Ocean. They are higher in Omega-3s because they eat rich diets of krill, squid and anchovies, ultimately making them fattier and vastly tastier. Albacores’ whiteness signifies quality: the whiter the Albacore, the fattier their diet.

We solely target Albacore that is 3-5 years old, weighing 11 to 16 pounds. By comparison, conventional canned tuna is fish that are around 15 years old, weighing over 60 pounds.

All of St Jude Tuna is canned locally in the Northwest. The Albacore are hand filleted and hand packed into a BPA-Free can and cooked in their own juices. This process is called cold-pack canning.

What about mercury?

Our young Albacore are under 5 years old which makes them naturally lower in mercury because they are caught in cold water, before they are old enough to migrate to tropical waters. Results from an Oregon State University study indicate that young Albacore are substantially lower in mercury. Our own tests (conducted by Food Quality Labs, in Portland, Oregon) corroborate this.

SUSTAINABILITY

The St. Jude, a 95-foot fishing vessel based in Seattle, Washington, participates exclusively in the troll fishery (individually line caught) for Albacore. This method is rated a “Best Choice” by the Monterey Bay Aquarium Seafood Watch, meaning that the numbers are healthy and bycatch and habitat impacts are minimal.

ABOUT US

The Malley's are a family business based in Seattle. Joe Malley began troll fishing in Sitka, Alaska in 1978.

Presently, Joe and his wife Joyce own the 95-foot fishing vessel St. Jude which trolls solely for Albacore tuna in the North and South Pacific, depending on the season.

It’s best to thaw seafood overnight in the refrigerator. Place the package on a plate or shallow pan to catch any liquid and allow 8-10 hours (for full fillets).

The History of Angelo Parodi

Fishing Areas, Methods and Protection of Marine Resources and Endangered Species

Angelo Parodi does NOT procure fish sourced from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.  We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction.

description:
The History of Angelo Parodi

Angelo Parodi dates to 1888 when the legendary Parodi created  the brand that for over 100 years, has brought to tables all over the world the Italian excellence in tuna and other fish specialties. A long history that has come down to us thanks to the ability of respecting the secrets of tradition combined with the constant search for progress in processing techniques. Angelo Parodi is the precursor of the modern method of conservation and canning of fish. The perfection of the flavor of the products is guaranteed by a strict quality control, the selection of the finest fish, a wise cutting and cleaning technique and finally by giving the seasoning just the right amount of time. Today Angelo Parodi extends his offering by proposing sardines and mackerel from the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts: products that with their characteristics of excellence make Angelo Parodi a legend among lovers of fish preserves.

 

Fishing Areas, Methods and Protection of Marine Resources and Endangered Species

Angelo Parodi does NOT procure fish sourced from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.  We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction.

title: St. Jude Tuna, Wild Albacore Tuna in Olive Oil, Puget Sound Family Business Widely Recognized For Its Sustainably U.S. Troll Caught, Dolphin-Free, Responsibly Superior Tasting Tuna, 6 oz (Pack of 3)
bullet_point: [Superior Flavor: Better Tasting Than Ordinary Canned Tuna - Healthy, Gluten Free, Good Food Awards Winner, Sushi-Grade Tuna, Sustainably Sourced: U.S. Troll Caught (No By-Catch), Harvested Responsibly, Health Benefits: Our Albacore Forage in the Colder Pacific NW Waters and Have a Higher Amount of Omega-3 Oils, Thoughtfully Processed: Wild Caught, U.S. Hand Packed, BPA-Free Pull-Tab Cans, 100% Sustainable, Dolphin Free, Certified & Best Choice: MSC Certified and Best Choice on Monterey Bay Seafood Watch Program]
description:
HEALTH BENEFITS

Why does our canned Albacore taste different than industrial tuna?

It’s different fish. Our Albacore are young, fatty fish individually line-caught in the cold waters of the North and South Pacific Ocean. They are higher in Omega-3s because they eat rich diets of krill, squid and anchovies, ultimately making them fattier and vastly tastier. Albacores’ whiteness signifies quality: the whiter the Albacore, the fattier their diet.

We solely target Albacore that is 3-5 years old, weighing 11 to 16 pounds. By comparison, conventional canned tuna is fish that are around 15 years old, weighing over 60 pounds.

All of St Jude Tuna is canned locally in the Northwest. The Albacore are hand filleted and hand packed into a BPA-Free can and cooked in their own juices. This process is called cold-pack canning.

What about mercury?

Our young Albacore are under 5 years old which makes them naturally lower in mercury because they are caught in cold water, before they are old enough to migrate to tropical waters. Results from an Oregon State University study indicate that young Albacore are substantially lower in mercury. Our own tests (conducted by Food Quality Labs, in Portland, Oregon) corroborate this.

SUSTAINABILITY

The St. Jude, a 95-foot fishing vessel based in Seattle, Washington, participates exclusively in the troll fishery (individually line caught) for Albacore. This method is rated a “Best Choice” by the Monterey Bay Aquarium Seafood Watch, meaning that the numbers are healthy and bycatch and habitat impacts are minimal.

ABOUT US

The Malley's are a family business based in Seattle. Joe Malley began troll fishing in Sitka, Alaska in 1978.

Presently, Joe and his wife Joyce own the 95-foot fishing vessel St. Jude which trolls solely for Albacore tuna in the North and South Pacific, depending on the season.

description:
The simplicity of eel, salt and smoke allows for the incredible natural oils to enhance the culinary experience. Formans smoked Dutch eel loses none of the natural oils during the subtle smoking process.

Our Story

When Harry (Aaron) Forman arrived in London’s East End from Russia at the beginning of the last century he pursued the trade he knew best – curing fish; in particular, the salmon he imported in barrels of brine from the Baltic. It wasn’t long, however, before he discovered a rich source of fresh wild salmon much closer to home: Scotland.

Inspired by the exceptional quality of fresh Scottish salmon, Harry developed a cure that complemented its unrivalled flavour. The deliciously mild London Cure was born and soon it was the talk of reputable establishments around the capital such as Wilton's restaurant which we have supplied for over 90 years with our genuine wild smoked Scottish salmon.

A century later H. Forman & Son remains a family concern, the last of the original London smokeries, with Lance Forman, Harry’s great grandson, flying the flag for the famous London Cure. Remaining faithful to principles established in 1905 – the freshest salmon, a little salt, just the right amount of oak smoke – he is upholding traditional values and skills that would otherwise have died out long ago, along with one of gastronomy’s finest foods: H. Forman & Son’s Genuine Wild Smoked Scottish Salmon.

Nuestra Tilapia es cultivada en lagos de agua dulce. Estos lagos son seleccionados por su calidad superior del agua y estándares ecológicos. Este método del lago es superior a la tilapia elevada del estanque, porque la calidad del agua es más limpia y sigue siendo más consistente durante todo el ciclo de vida de los peces. En las jaulas del lago, los residuos se diluyen en miles de hectáreas de agua y se consumen naturalmente por las plantas silvestres y la vida marina, por lo que el lago está siempre en equilibrio y el sabor de los peces sigue siendo consistente. Los filetes de tilapia son blancos demasiado rosados y pueden tener una capa delgada de tejido muscular más oscuro justo debajo del lado de la piel en estado crudo. Tilapia se cocina de color blanco con un sabor suave y una textura ligeramente firme y flakey.

description:
The simplicity of eel, salt and smoke allows for the incredible natural oils to enhance the culinary experience. Formans smoked Dutch eel loses none of the natural oils during the subtle smoking process.

Our Story

When Harry (Aaron) Forman arrived in London’s East End from Russia at the beginning of the last century he pursued the trade he knew best – curing fish; in particular, the salmon he imported in barrels of brine from the Baltic. It wasn’t long, however, before he discovered a rich source of fresh wild salmon much closer to home: Scotland.

Inspired by the exceptional quality of fresh Scottish salmon, Harry developed a cure that complemented its unrivalled flavour. The deliciously mild London Cure was born and soon it was the talk of reputable establishments around the capital such as Wilton's restaurant which we have supplied for over 90 years with our genuine wild smoked Scottish salmon.

A century later H. Forman & Son remains a family concern, the last of the original London smokeries, with Lance Forman, Harry’s great grandson, flying the flag for the famous London Cure. Remaining faithful to principles established in 1905 – the freshest salmon, a little salt, just the right amount of oak smoke – he is upholding traditional values and skills that would otherwise have died out long ago, along with one of gastronomy’s finest foods: H. Forman & Son’s Genuine Wild Smoked Scottish Salmon.

description: SalMŭria is an amber liquid seasoning that is generated through a traditional process of maturation of anchovies with salt. Engraulis encrasicolus is fished by traditional methods on the coast of the Cantabrian Sea. The anchovies, freshly caught and unloaded from the boat, are kept for 24 hours in containers with abundant saltwater. After being gutted, they are placed in barrels, alternating with layers of salt. After a maturation period of about 12-18 months, the production of the anchovy begins and the SalMŭria (anchovy extract) is collected and stored. Finally, it is filtered and is ready for consumption. It is called SalMŭria: Umami in a liquid state. It has an amber color and is a natural flavor, with no additives. It can be added to dishes primarily as an ingredient with properties similar to salt. In Asian cuisine, it is used as a cooking oil and as an ingredient in soup making, analogously to soy sauce. It is usually used in moderation because it provides intense aromas. Mixed with wine, vinegar, pepper, oil, or water, it can dress other delicacies, season, or accompany meals such as vegetables, salads, rice, bread, as well as soups and broths. It can also be used with meats since its flavor is ideal for marinating or frying them. In Italian cuisine. it is mainly used as a dressing in pasta or with vegetables sautéed in oil, garlic, and chilies. SalMŭria can be used to cook, transform, cure, soften, and marinate different raw foods such as vegetables, seafood, eggs, fish, meats, etc.

description: Yellowfin tuna Smoked over hardwood Premium grade cut from the loin Lightly cured, not cooked Add to salads or canapés Size - 7 oz/200 gr This delicious smoked tuna is delicate and tender, with an enticing smokiness that we can't resist. We serve paper thin slices on canapés with cream cheese and pickled guindilla peppers. Sometimes we prefer the slices drizzled with olive oil and served on flavorful crackers. Any recipe that features smoked salmon can be elevated with this flavorful smoked tuna. Our friends at Salazones Garre in Murcia are masters at preserving tuna. The classic salt cured tuna, mojama, originated thousands of years ago and is popular to this day. The latest generation who run this family-owned company decided to create a cured tuna that is more delicate and less intense than traditional mojama. They began to test different recipes. This smoked tuna is the fruit of their quest. A whole fresh loin of yellowfin tuna is lightly salted, then hardwood smoked in cool conditions. This careful curing helps it to retain its delicate texture. The resulting tuna is almost sushi-like in texture but with a light saltiness and a bright smoky flavor.

description:
Once a frozen fillet is completely thawed, it can be re-frozen though we do not recommend it, as taste and quality may begin to suffer. No fillet should be re-frozen if it has been thawed 2 days or longer.

The best way to thaw your wild salmon dinner fillet is to leave it in the refrigerator overnight (in its pouch), allowing at least 8-10 hours. Trying to rush the process by thawing at room temperature or placing the frozen pouch in warm water is definitely NOT recommended, as it can cause the salmon to lose flavor and texture. If you must thaw your salmon quickly, place the frozen pouch in a bowl of cool water for 30-45 minutes, and then continue thawing in refrigerator.

TO BAKE: Pre-heat oven to 275°F. Place salmon fillet skin side down on a cookie sheet brushed with olive oil, and bake for approximately 20 minutes. Do not flip salmon fillet.

TO GRILL: Brush grill with olive oil PRIOR to heating. Once the grill is medium-hot (you should be able to hold your hand 6 inches above the grill for 5 seconds), brush the top of each salmon fillet with olive oil, and place on grill skin side up. Grill fillet until sides begin to turn opaque. Flip once, and continue grilling until fully cooked.

TO BROIL: Place salmon fillet skin side down on a broiler pan brushed with olive oil, and place on oven’s middle rack. Generally broil about 10 minutes or so, though keep watching to avoid overcooking. Do not flip salmon fillet.

description:
Fish Maw is sun-dried swim bladder of fish which is an internal gas-filled organ found in most fish. It is commonly used in Chinese cooking and in Chinese soups. Fish Maw is an excellent source of collagen.

How to serve

Preparation
1. Prepare a clean pot and make sure no oil attached.
2. Rinse the fish maw with clean water and put on a dish. (Put some ginger or scallion if you do not like the raw fish smell)
3. Steam the dish for 5 - 20 minutes depends on the size and thickness of the fish maw.
4. Soak the fish maw in clean water for 1 - 3 days until it is soft enough to cook. Keep changing water twice a day.

RECIPE

Sea Cucumber Fish Maw Soup
Ingredients: 3 sea cucumbers, 80g fish maw, 300g pork shin
1. Rinse all the ingredients thoroughly and blanch pork shin.
2. Combine all ingredients with 2500ml of water in a pot. Place over high heat until the water boils and then switch to low heat to simmer for additional 2 hours. Add salt to taste.

description:
Superior grade Scottish salmon cured in dill, star-anise, & orange. This age old Scandinavian delicacy is made by 'pressing' the salmon with the cure for 48 hours. Formans takes great care in delivering to our customers the most delicious version of this centuries old cured salmon luxury.

Our Story

When Harry (Aaron) Forman arrived in London’s East End from Russia at the beginning of the last century he pursued the trade he knew best – curing fish; in particular, the salmon he imported in barrels of brine from the Baltic. It wasn’t long, however, before he discovered a rich source of fresh wild salmon much closer to home: Scotland.

Inspired by the exceptional quality of fresh Scottish salmon, Harry developed a cure that complemented its unrivalled flavour. The deliciously mild London Cure was born and soon it was the talk of reputable establishments around the capital such as Wilton's restaurant which we have supplied for over 90 years with our genuine wild smoked Scottish salmon.

A century later H. Forman & Son remains a family concern, the last of the original London smokeries, with Lance Forman, Harry’s great grandson, flying the flag for the famous London Cure. Remaining faithful to principles established in 1905 – the freshest salmon, a little salt, just the right amount of oak smoke – he is upholding traditional values and skills that would otherwise have died out long ago, along with one of gastronomy’s finest foods: H. Forman & Son’s Genuine Wild Smoked Scottish Salmon.

description: When you live on the coast of Maine, your life is ruled by water. Waves, gulls in the sky, the thrilling tug of a fish on the line. Our herring, mackerel, and kippers keep the clean bite of cold, clear water in mind. All our seafood has the snap of crisp offshore wind, and is made by people who grew up on the water. It's as close to "fresh off the boat" as you can get. Bar Harbor Foods sits on a picturesque wharf on a beautiful sheltered cove in Down east Maine. The cries of gulls echo across the water; the tide laps against pilings as the tie lines of the fishing boats stretch and creak in the sun and fog. This is where we make our premium specialty seafood – fresh off the docks of Maine. While the business has expanded and changed over the past 85 years, Down east Maine still inspires all our products. Our premium foods reflect naturally delicious New England cuisine and authentic Maine traditions. We like to keep things simple, from original recipes and fresh natural ingredients, to the appealing simplicity of our labels. Our specialty seafood and other fine foods are made in small batches and packed and canned mostly by hand, just like people on the coast of Maine have been doing for generations. Bar Harbor is a special place – you can taste it!

The History of Angelo Parodi

Angelo Parodi dates to 1888 when the legendary Parodi created  the brand that for over 100 years, has brought to tables all over the world the Italian excellence in tuna and other fish specialties. A long history that has come down to us thanks to the ability of respecting the secrets of tradition combined with the constant search for progress in processing techniques. Angelo Parodi is the precursor of the modern method of conservation and canning of fish. The perfection of the flavor of the products is guaranteed by a strict quality control, the selection of the finest fish, a wise cutting and cleaning technique and finally by giving the seasoning just the right amount of time. Today Angelo Parodi extends his offering by proposing sardines and mackerel from the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts: products that with their characteristics of excellence make Angelo Parodi a legend among lovers of fish preserves.

 

Fishing Areas, Methods and Protection of Marine Resources and Endangered Species

Angelo Parodi does NOT procure fish sourced from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.  We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction.

Sustainable Seas sources tuna caught only by pole and line. There is virtually no by-catch associated with the trolling or pole and line techniques, which are regarded as the best fishing methods for tuna, a fact worth remembering when you buy.

Pole and line fishing has been practiced for centuries in several different parts of the world. The method involves attracting a school of tuna to the side of a baitboat by throwing live sardines and anchovies overboard. This creates a tuna feeding frenzy and fish are hauled out of the water, one-by-one, using pole and line with an artificial lure attached. The size of tuna caught this way is almost exclusively younger migratory tuna that are also lower in mercury than the older tuna caught deeper with long-lines. Rethink your relationship with the seas.BE SUSTAINABLE

description:
Wild smoked Scottish salmon is unique in flavor, texture and is overall considered a nostalgic culinary experience. Formans hand prepares every side of salmon, from the filleting to the rope hanging to the pin-bone removal to the hand carving. There's no sugar, no nitrites, no added coloring and no wet brine. You will receive the finest Wild smoked Scottish salmon direct to your door.

Our Story

When Harry (Aaron) Forman arrived in London’s East End from Russia at the beginning of the last century he pursued the trade he knew best – curing fish; in particular, the salmon he imported in barrels of brine from the Baltic. It wasn’t long, however, before he discovered a rich source of fresh wild salmon much closer to home: Scotland.

Inspired by the exceptional quality of fresh Scottish salmon, Harry developed a cure that complemented its unrivalled flavour. The deliciously mild London Cure was born and soon it was the talk of reputable establishments around the capital such as Wilton's restaurant which we have supplied for over 90 years with our genuine wild smoked Scottish salmon.

A century later H. Forman & Son remains a family concern, the last of the original London smokeries, with Lance Forman, Harry’s great grandson, flying the flag for the famous London Cure. Remaining faithful to principles established in 1905 – the freshest salmon, a little salt, just the right amount of oak smoke – he is upholding traditional values and skills that would otherwise have died out long ago, along with one of gastronomy’s finest foods: H. Forman & Son’s Genuine Wild Smoked Scottish Salmon.

Packaging:
Our orders are carefully packed using dry ice inside insulated inserts in a corrugated shipping box. Your fish will remain frozen for you to put right in the freezer until you’re ready to eat!

Thawing:
It’s best to thaw seafood overnight in the refrigerator. Place the package on a plate or shallow pan to catch any liquid and allow 8-10 hours (for full fillets).

Never allow seafood to thaw at room temperature or place in water to thaw. Flavor and texture are both lost this way.

Our sockeye salmon is wild caught and has a flavor that is unrivaled because our process is simple. We catch and process only our fish. All of our fish is processed and flash frozen within hours of harvest. This keeps the fish fresh and helps maintain the nutrients and flavor that so many of our customers are searching for. Each individually seal portion is aproximately 6 ounces and can contain between 1,500-2,000mg of Omega-3’s and close to 1,110 IU of Vitamin D3. 10 lbs. of sockeye can vary form 16 to 20 individual steak packets.

Wild Alaskan Sockeye Salmon are a sustainably managed species by the state of Alaska, and many health organizations, included but not limited to, the EPA and FDA, view Sockeye Salmon as one of the cleanest of all ocean fish. As a 100% fisherman family owned small business, we believe in one thing: providing you with a product that we are equally as excited to eat. The quality and taste are unsurpassed and the level of freshness can only get better if you join us on the boat! Portion fillets range in size from 6-12 oz. each depending on the size of the fish they are hand cut from. Each piece serves 1-2 people. The 5 lb. box contains 10-15 pieces. Our portioned fillets make for an easy dinner option any day of the week.

description: Silky tuna from the Basque Country Whole cut of tuna packed by hand Line caught Packed in olive oil Dolphin friendly, sustainably caught Size -3.25 oz/92 gr Bonito del Norte will transform your concept of tuna in a can. Each tin reveals a whole cut of fish, bathed in olive oil. Add flakes of this silky smooth tuna to elevate your next fresh salad, or toss it with capers, diced cucumber and parsley for a tuna salad to remember. Each Bonito del Norte tuna is line-caught individually in the cold waters north of Spain. Once in port in the Basque Country the tuna is poached in sea water, cut by hand and packed in olive oil to keep it moist and flavorful. Colman Andrews, former Editor-in Chief of Saveur Magazine, writes that Bonito tuna is ""one of the great gastronomic pleasures of every day life."" The delicate flavor and texture of Bonito tuna is preserved by a dolphin-safe line-catching method, as it avoids the stress damage caused by harvesting by net. Basque anglers literally catch each tuna by line and hook, pulling them into the boat one by one. There is almost no by-catch, making it the most ecological way to harvest tuna. Warning: once you taste this silky smooth tuna, you may never buy another tin of ordinary tuna!

description:
The History of Angelo Parodi

Angelo Parodi dates to 1888 when the legendary Parodi created  the brand that for over 100 years, has brought to tables all over the world the Italian excellence in tuna and other fish specialties. A long history that has come down to us thanks to the ability of respecting the secrets of tradition combined with the constant search for progress in processing techniques. Angelo Parodi is the precursor of the modern method of conservation and canning of fish. The perfection of the flavor of the products is guaranteed by a strict quality control, the selection of the finest fish, a wise cutting and cleaning technique and finally by giving the seasoning just the right amount of time. Today Angelo Parodi extends his offering by proposing sardines and mackerel from the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts: products that with their characteristics of excellence make Angelo Parodi a legend among lovers of fish preserves.

 

Fishing Areas, Methods and Protection of Marine Resources and Endangered Species

Angelo Parodi does NOT procure fish sourced from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.  We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction.

The perfection of the flavor of the products is guaranteed by a strict quality control, the selection of the finest fish, a wise cutting and cleaning technique and, finally by giving the seasoning just the right amount of time.

Today Angelo Parodi extends his offering by proposing sardines and mackerel from the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts: products that with their characteristics of excellence make Angelo Parodi a legend among lovers of fish preserves.

Fishing areas and methods

Angelo Parodi does not fish products coming from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by the coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.

Protection of marine resources and endangered species

We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction. We only deal with suppliers who promote measures to reduce waste and discharges into the sea and encourage compliance with fishing bans.

description: A true symbol of Portuguese gastronomy, canned sardines are highly appreciated the World over and represent a market with great international potential. Cofaco was created in 1961, as the result of a merger of two large canneries in the Algarve – Centeno, Cumbrera & Ca. and Raul Folque & Filhos. Based in Vila Real de Santo António, they were, at the time, the largest Portuguese canning group. During the second half of the 20th century fishing started drying up along the Algarve coast, forcing fishermen to go further and further afield in search of the fish. To overcome this situation, the canning industry began to relocate, and in 1962 Cofaco settled in the Azores – an “oasis” in the Atlantic Ocean. Hence, a year later, a plant was officially inaugurated on the island of Pico, and production began at the first Cofaco factory in the Azores. It subsequently relocated to Ribeira Grande, where Cofaco inaugurated the industrial hub of Rabo de Peixe in 1994, and where it still concentrates a large part of its production. Currently, Cofaco is the largest industrial employer in the Azores archipelago, and has a significant bearing on the region’s GDP.

Serving Suggestions
As do Mar is our tuna of choice for Salade Niçoise, and it's a perfect addition to any antipasto plate. Or try it on a bed of greens with sliced, ripe tomatoes and a handful of good olives for an easy, delicious and very healthy lunch - no mayo required!

About As Do Mar
Off the southwest coastline of Europe lie the tiny Azores, a chain of Portuguese islands that are right in the middle of prime Atlantic tuna grounds. As Do Mar tuna is line caught, and processed while still fresh. The solid flesh of the yellowfin tuna is richer in fats than albacore, which means that the meat is darker - pink to reddish - and it is moister and richer in flavor.

About the Tuna
Bigeye tuna is a species that travels with schools of yellowfin, but swims beneath them to even greater depths. The result of swimming in this deeper, colder, water is an even higher fat content and richer flavor. Occasionally, bigeye are caught along with the yellowfin and not separated, so you may get a bonus of bigeye in your can!

Cofaco was created in 1961, as the result of a merger of two large canneries in the Algarve – Centeno, Cumbrera & Ca. and Raul Folque & Filhos. Based in Vila Real de Santo António, they were, at the time, the largest Portuguese canning group. During the second half of the 20th century fishing started drying up along the Algarve coast, forcing fishermen to go further and further afield in search of the fish. To overcome this situation, the canning industry began to relocate, and in 1962 Cofaco settled in the Azores – an “oasis” in the Atlantic Ocean. Hence, a year later, a plant was officially inaugurated on the island of Pico, and production began at the first Cofaco factory in the Azores. It subsequently relocated to Ribeira Grande, where Cofaco inaugurated the industrial hub of Rabo de Peixe in 1994, and where it still concentrates a large part of its production. Currently, Cofaco is the largest industrial employer in the Azores archipelago, and has a significant bearing on the region’s GDP.

description:
FAQ's

What Do You Feed Your Salmon?

Our goal is to provide a long-term sustainable diet that meets all the nutritional requirements of King Salmon. The feed carries Certificates of Analysis from registered laboratories, is certified GMO-free and BSE-free, and all ingredients are fully traceable. The feed consists of fish meal (sourced from sustainable fisheries), fish oil, animal protein and oil, vegetable protein meals, wheat/starch, vitamins, and minerals including the antioxidant Astaxanthin.

Do You Dye Your Salmon?

No. Our salmon feed contains Astaxanthin which is naturally found in Algae and krill and is an essential micro-nutrient for salmon. It’s so important to the salmon that they have the capacity to store the Astaxanthin in their muscle tissue because that is what makes them pink. Astaxanthin is a powerful antioxidant that is also found in other foods including dietary supplements.

Is Your Environment Clean?

Throughout their life, our salmon experience arguably the cleanest rearing environment found anywhere in the world. As smolt, they are nurtured in the safe sanctuaries of our pure mountain fed streams before being transferred to sea farms located in the remote, crystal clear sea waters of the Marlborough Sounds.

bullet_point: [Authentic Italian Colatura di Alici, Praised by Lidia Bastianich in Wall St. Journal, Umami, from Anchovies, Slow Food Selection, Excellent with pasta, steamed fish, and broccoli, 100 ml in bottle]
description:
This ingredient may seem a bit unusual, but it is a traditional preparation from southern Italy. This distillate is a fish sauce extracted from cured anchovies. Each batch takes five months to produce.

Featured in the Wall Street Journal’s Guide to the Best in Summer Food (May 14, 2011), Lidia Bastianich says, “…It has the effect of umami and it brings out flavor in everything you do…”

Ittica Alimentare Salerno (IASA) uses only premium anchovies harvested in the Mediterranean. IASA is located in the small village of Cetara, south of Naples, on the Amalfi coast. They have been processing freshly caught anchovies since 1969.

One of the treasured ingredients of the region, Colatura di Alici, has roots that date back to ancient Rome. Until recently this ingredient was rarely found in the United States. Colatura di Alici is recognized and protected by Slow Food.

Traditional suggestions include using a small splash of colatura with browned garlic, chili flakes, extra virgin olive oil, parsley, and toasted breadcrumbs on pasta. Another lovely pasta dish is orecchiette with cauliflower, garlic, chilies, raisins and pine nuts and a hint of colatura. Also a favorite with dishes such as steamed broccoli, braised sea bass, or substituted for anchovies in Caesar salad. Always start with a small splash!

description:
The History of Angelo Parodi

Angelo Parodi dates to 1888 when the legendary Parodi created  the brand that for over 100 years, has brought to tables all over the world the Italian excellence in tuna and other fish specialties. A long history that has come down to us thanks to the ability of respecting the secrets of tradition combined with the constant search for progress in processing techniques. Angelo Parodi is the precursor of the modern method of conservation and canning of fish. The perfection of the flavor of the products is guaranteed by a strict quality control, the selection of the finest fish, a wise cutting and cleaning technique and finally by giving the seasoning just the right amount of time. Today Angelo Parodi extends his offering by proposing sardines and mackerel from the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts: products that with their characteristics of excellence make Angelo Parodi a legend among lovers of fish preserves.

 

Fishing Areas, Methods and Protection of Marine Resources and Endangered Species

Angelo Parodi does NOT procure fish sourced from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.  We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction.

description:
Your wild salmon fillets have been quick-frozen to lock in their flavor and nutrients, and shipped to you on dry ice. Upon arrival, please freeze or refrigerate. Fillets will keep in the freezer for approximately 3-4 months; once thawed they should be cooked and used within 1-2 days. Once a frozen fillet is completely thawed, it can be re-frozen though we do not recommend it, as taste and quality may begin to suffer. No fillet should be re-frozen if it has been thawed 2 days or longer.

Regardless of how you like to cook your salmon (bake, broil, grill, sauté or poach), we believe the key to success is to SLOW DOWN! Slow cooking locks in the natural juices of the salmon, for a more succulent flavor. When the salmon has turned from translucent to just about completely opaque the salmon is done. At this point the salmon should begin to flake easily with a fork. It is important to note that once removed from the heat, your salmon will continue to cook for several more minutes. Here are some specific guidelines by cooking method:

TO BAKE: Pre-heat oven to 275°F. Place salmon fillet skin side down on a cookie sheet brushed with olive oil, and bake for approximately 20 minutes. Do not flip salmon fillet.

TO GRILL: Brush grill with olive oil PRIOR to heating. Once the grill is medium-hot (you should be able to hold your hand 6 inches above the grill for 5 seconds), brush the top of each salmon fillet with olive oil, and place on grill skin side up. Grill fillet until sides begin to turn opaque. Flip once, and continue grilling until fully cooked.

TO BROIL: Place salmon fillet skin side down on a broiler pan brushed with olive oil, and place on oven’s middle rack. Generally broil about 10 minutes or so, though keep watching to avoid overcooking. Do not flip salmon fillet.

title: Lobster Gram Sockeye Salmon - Four 6 oz. Sockeye Salmon Fillets
bullet_point: [Sockeye Salmon are found throughout the North Pacific Ocean and inhabit most coastal streams and rivers from Alaska to Central California., The fillets are bright red with a fine, firm texture., The flavor is rich and robust. Sockeye Salmon are considered the most flavorful and versatile of the salmon family.]
description:
Sockeye Salmon are found throughout the North Pacific Ocean and inhabit most coastal streams and rivers from Alaska to Central California. The fillets are bright red with a fine, firm texture. The flavor is rich and robust. Sockeye Salmon are considered the most flavorful and versatile of the salmon family. Our boneless Sockeye Salmon fillets are flash frozen in tray packs of two 6 oz. Fillets for convenience - thaw only the tray packs that you need and the rest can remain frozen. Delivered frozen in a Lobster Gram Insulated cooler. Thaw and serve or freeze for up to 6 months. We love it roasted on a sheet pan with our favorite marinade, here's how to do it: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. In a bowl, mix together 1 tablespoon of maple syrup, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard, and 1-1/2 teaspoons of chili powder. Pour over two 6 oz. Fillets and roast for about 18 minutes, or until salmon is cooked through. Enjoy!

El salmón Sockeye se encuentra en todo el Océano Pacífico Norte y habitan la mayoría de los arroyos y ríos costeros desde Alaska hasta California Central. Los filetes son de color rojo brillante con una textura fina y firme. El sabor es rico y robusto. Sockeye Salmon son considerados los más sabrosos y versátiles de la familia del salmón. Nuestros filetes de salmón Sockeye sin hueso están congelados en paquetes de bandejas de dos 6 oz. Filetes para mayor comodidad, descongele solo los paquetes de bandejas que necesita y el resto puede permanecer congelado. Se entrega congelado en un refrigerador aislado de langosta gramo. Descongelar y servir o congelar hasta 6 meses. Nos encanta asado en una sartén con nuestro adobo favorito, así es como hacerlo: Precalentar el horno a 350 grados F. En un bol, mezclar 1 cucharada de jarabe de arce, 1 cucharada de salsa de soja, 1 cucharadita de mostaza de Dijon y 1-1/2 cucharaditas de chile en polvo. Vierta más de dos 6 oz. Filetes y asados durante unos 18 minutos, o hasta que el salmón se coce. Disfrutar!

סלמון Sockeye נמצא ברחבי האוקיינוס הצפון פסיפי ומאכלס את רוב נחלים ונהרות החוף מאלסקה למרכז קליפורניה. הפילה אדומה בהירה עם מרקם עדין ומוצק. הטעם עשיר וחזק. סלמון Sockeye נחשב לטעים והרב-תכליתי ביותר של משפחת הסלמון. פילה הסלמון ללא העצמות שלנו מוקפאים במהירות בחבילות מגש של 2 עוז פילה לנוחות - הפשרה רק את חבילות המגש שאתה צריך והשאר יכול להישאר קפוא. נשלח קפוא במקרר מבודד לובסטר גרם. הפשירו והגשו או הקפאו עד 6 חודשים. אנחנו אוהבים את זה קלוי על מחבת עם המרינדה האהובה עלינו, הנה איך לעשות את זה: חממו מראש את התנור ל-350 מעלות צלזיוס. בקערה, ערבבו יחד כף אחת של סירופ מייפל, כף אחת של רוטב סויה, כפית חרדל דיז'ון, ו-1-1/2 כפיות של אבקת צ'ילי. יוצקים מעל שני פילה 170 גרם וצלייה במשך כ-18 דקות, או עד שהסלמון מבושל דרכו. תהנו!

Sockeye Lachs sind im Nordpazifischen Ozean gefunden und bewohnen die meisten Küstenströme und Flüsse von Alaska bis Zentralkalifornien. Die Filets sind leuchtend rot mit einer feinen, festen Struktur. Der Geschmack ist reich und robust. Sockeye Lachs gelten als der aromatischste und vielseitigste der Lachsfamilie. Unsere Sockeye-Lachsfilets ohne Knochen werden in Schalen mit zwei 170 ml Inhalt gefroren. Filets für Komfort – tauen Sie nur die Tablet-Packs auf, die Sie brauchen, und der Rest kann gefroren bleiben. Wird in einem isolierten Hummer Gram Kühler geliefert. Bis zu 6 Monate auftauen und servieren oder einfrieren. Wir lieben es auf einem Blech mit unserer Lieblingsmarinade geröstet und geht's: Ofen auf 350 °C vorheizen. In einer Schüssel 1 Esslöffel Ahornsirup, 1 Esslöffel Sojasauce, 1 Teelöffel Dijon-Senf, 1 Teelöffel Chilipulver. Über zwei 170 ml gießen. Filets und ca. 18 Minuten braten oder bis Lachs durchkocht ist. Genießen!

يوجد سلمون سوكي في جميع أنحاء المحيط الهادئ ويشجع معظم التيارات والأنهار الساحلية من ألاسكا إلى وسط كاليفورنيا. الشعيرات حمراء زاهية مع ملمس ناعم وثابت. النكهة غنية وقوية. يعتبر سالمون الأكثر نكهة وتنوعًا من عائلة السالمون. يتم وضع شرائح السلمون سوكي آي بدون عظمة في عبوات تحتوي على زجاجتين بسعة 170 مل من أجل الراحة - قم بإذابة عبوات الصينية التي تحتاجها وستظل بقية الطعام مجمدة. يتم تسليمها المجمد في مبرد معزول بالجرام على شكل سرطان البحر. قم بإذابة وقدم أو تجميد لمدة تصل إلى 6 أشهر. نحن نحبه محمص على صينية مع التتبيلة المفضلة لدينا، إليك كيفية القيام به: قم بتسخين الفرن حتى 350 درجة فهرنهايت. في وعاء، امزج ملعقة كبيرة من شراب القيقب وملعقة كبيرة من صلصة الصويا وملعقة صغيرة من خردل ديجون وملعقة صغيرة من مسحوق الفلفل الحار اسكب أكثر من اثنين من شرائح القهوة سعة 170 مل وقم بتحميص لمدة 18 دقيقة أو حتى يتم طهي السالمون. استمتع!

Os salmão Sockeye são encontrados em todo o Oceano Pacífico Norte e habitam a maioria dos rios e rios costeiros do Alasca à Califórnia Central. Os filetes são vermelhos brilhantes com uma textura fina e firme. O sabor é rico e robusto. O salmão Sockeye é considerado o mais saboroso e versátil da família de salmão. Nossos filetes de salmão Sockeye sem osso são congelados em embalagens de bandeja com dois filetes de 170 g para conveniência – descongele apenas os pacotes de bandeja que você precisa e o resto pode permanecer congelado. Entregue congelado em um refrigerador isolado lagosta. Descongele e sirva ou congele por até 6 meses. Adoramos isso assado em uma assadeira com nossa marinada favorita, aqui está como fazer: Pré-aqueça o forno a 350 graus Celsius. Em uma tigela, misture 1 colher de sopa de xarope de bordo, 1 colher de sopa de molho de soja, 1 colher de chá de mostarda Dijon e 1-1/2 colheres de chá de pimenta em pó. Despeje mais de dois filetes de 170 g e torre por cerca de 18 minutos, ou até que o salmão esteja cozido. Aproveite!

Sockeye 鮭魚遍佈北太平洋,從阿拉斯加到加州的大多數沿海溪流和河流。 圓角為亮紅色,質地細膩、牢固。 風味豐富且堅固。 Sockeye 鮭魚被認為是鮭魚家族中最美味、最多功能的。 我們的無骨 Sockeye 三文魚片在兩個約 170.14 克的托盤包裝中閃冷凍。 方便使用 - 只有您需要的托盤包裝,其餘可以保持冷凍。 使用龍蝦扣隔熱保冷袋冷凍。 解凍並食用或冷凍長達 6 個月。 我們喜歡它在烤盤上烤,用我們最喜歡的醃汁,以下是該怎麼做:烤箱預熱至 350 華氏度。在碗裡,將 1 湯匙楓糖漿、1 湯匙醬油、1 茶匙第戎芥末和 1-1/2 茶匙辣椒粉混合在一起。 倒入兩個 6 盎司(約 170.1 克)的玉米片並烤約 18 分鐘,或直至鮭魚煮熟。 好好享受!

鲑鱼遍布北太平洋,从阿拉斯加到加利福尼亚州中部的大多数海岸溪流和河流。 圆角是亮红色,质地细腻坚固。 味道丰富而坚固。 鲑鱼被认为是三文鱼家族中最美味和最多功能的。 我们的无骨鲑鱼鱼鱼片在两包 6 盎司的托盘中快速冷冻,方便使用 - 仅解冻您需要的托盘包,其余的托盘可以保持冷冻。 发货时采用龙虾克保温冷却器。 解冻、盛菜或冷冻长达 6 个月。 我们喜欢用我们最喜欢的腌料在平底锅上烤制,下面是如何做的:预热烤箱 350 华氏度。在碗里,将 1 汤匙枫糖浆、1 汤匙酱油、1 茶匙芥末和 1-1/2 茶匙辣椒粉。 倒入两片 6 盎司(约 170.1 克)的小圆片并烘烤约 18 分钟,或直至三文鱼煮熟。 尽情享受吧!

Sockeye Salmon은 북태평양 전역에서 발견되며 알래스카에서 중앙 캘리포니아까지 대부분의 해안 개울과 강에 서식합니다. 필렛은 밝은 빨간색으로 섬세하고 단단한 질감을 가지고 있습니다. 풍미가 풍부하고 견고합니다. Sockeye Salmon은 연어 가문의 가장 맛있고 다재다능한 것으로 간주됩니다. 본리스 삭아이 연어 필레는 170.1g(6온스) 2개의 트레이 팩에 플래쉬 얼려 있어 편리합니다. 필렛 - 필요한 트레이 팩만 해동하고 나머지는 얼린 상태로 유지됩니다. 랍스터 그램 단열 쿨러로 냉동 상태로 배송됩니다. 최대 6개월 동안 해동하고 서빙하거나 얼릴 수 있습니다. 좋아하는 마리네이드와 함께 시트 팬에 구운 것을 좋아합니다. 오븐을 350도까지 예열하십시오. 그릇에 메이플 시럽 1 큰 스푼, 간장 1 큰 스푼, 디존 겨자 1 티스푼, 칠리 파우더 1 티스푼을 섞습니다. 두 개의 6온스 필렛을 붓고 약 18분 동안 또는 연어가 요리될 때까지 굽습니다. 즐기세요!

description:
When Sasquatch heads down to the river, his favorite catch is the wild salmon. He loves the tender; mild flavor of this wild pink salmon, and of course he appreciates it as a natural source of Omega 3/6/9 fatty acids! Smoked in the traditional Northwest style, Sasquatch’s catch is moist, flaky, fully cooked – unlike other smoked salmon (he won’t have it any other way). Enjoy, but we recommend you eat it quickly --- you never know when Sasquatch might venture out of the woods to steal it from you!

Cuando Sasquatch se dirige al río, su captura favorita es el salmón salvaje. Le encanta la tierna; sabor suave de este salmón rosa salvaje, y por supuesto lo aprecia como una fuente natural de ácidos grasos Omega 3/6/9! Ahumado al estilo tradicional del noroeste, la captura de Sasquatch es húmeda, escamosa, totalmente cocinada, a diferencia de otros salmones ahumados (no lo tendrá de otra manera). Disfruta, pero le recomendamos que lo coma rápidamente --- nunca se sabe cuándo Sasquatch podría aventurarse fuera del bosque para robarlo!

כאשר ססקואץ' יוצא אל הנהר, המלכוד האהוב עליו הוא הסלמון הפראי. הוא אוהב את העדין; טעם עדין של הסלמון הוורוד הפראי הזה, וכמובן הוא מעריך את זה כמקור טבעי של חומצות שומן אומגה 3/6/9! מעושן בסגנון צפון מערב מסורתי, התפיסה של Sasquatch היא לחה, קשקשית, מבושלת במלואה – בניגוד לסלמון מעושן אחר (לא יהיה לו שום דרך אחרת). תהנה, אבל אנו ממליצים לך לאכול את זה במהירות --- אתה אף פעם לא יודע מתי Sasquatch עלול לצאת מהיער כדי לגנוב אותו ממך!

Wenn Sasquatch in den Fluss geht, ist sein Lieblingsfang der wilde Lachs. Er liebt den zarten, milden Geschmack dieses wilden rosa Lachs und natürlich schätzt er ihn als natürliche Quelle von Omega 3/6/9 Fettsäuren. Im traditionellen Nordwest-Stil geraucht ist der Fang von Sasquatch feucht, schuppig, vollständig gekocht – im Gegensatz zu anderen geräucherten Lachs (er hat ihn nicht anderweitig). Genießen, aber wir empfehlen Ihnen, es schnell zu essen – Sie wissen nie, wann Sasquatch aus dem Wald gewagt wird, um es aus Ihnen zu stehlen!

عندما يتجه ساسكواتش إلى النهر، فإن قبضته المفضلة هي السلمون البري. إنه يحب الرداء؛ نكهة خفيفة لهذا السلمون الوردي البري، وبالطبع فإنه يقدر ذلك كمصدر طبيعي لأحماض أوميجا 3/6/9 الدهنية! يتميز مقبض ساسكواتش بنمط شمال غرب تقليدي، بأنه رطب وقشر وطهو بالكامل - على عكس السلمون المدخن الآخر (لن يكون له بأي طريقة أخرى). استمتع، لكننا ننصحك بتناول الطعام بسرعة --- لن تعرف أبدًا متى قد يخترق ساسكواتش من الغابة لسرقتها!

Quando Sasquatch vai até o rio, sua captura favorita é o salmão selvagem. Ele adora o sabor suave deste salmão rosa selvagem e, é claro, ele aprecia como uma fonte natural de ácidos graxos 3/6/9! Defumada no estilo tradicional noroeste, a captura de Sasquatch é úmida, escamosa, totalmente cozida – ao contrário de outros salmão defumado (ele não terá de outra maneira). Aproveite, mas recomendamos que você coma rapidamente --- você nunca sabe quando Sasquatch pode se aventurar para fora da floresta para roubar de você!

当 Sasquatch 冲向河流时,他最喜欢的捕获是野生鲑鱼。 他喜欢这种柔和;这种野生粉色鲑鱼的温和风味,当然他认为它是Omega 3/6/9脂肪酸的天然来源! 采用传统西北风格烟熏,Sasquatch的捕捉物是湿润的、薄的、完全烹制的 - 与其他烟熏三文鱼不同(他不会拥有这种方式)。 享受,但我们建议你快速吃掉它 --- 你永远不知道什么时候 Sasquatch 从树林里冒险来盗取它!

當 Sasquatch 往河邊時,他最喜歡的捕捉物就是野生鮭魚。 他喜歡這款野生粉紅鮭魚的溫和風味,當然他也很感激它作為Omega 3/6/9脂肪酸的天然來源! Sasquatch 採用傳統西北風格煙熏,具有濕潤、酥脆、完全熟 – 不同於其他煙燻鮭魚(他沒有任何其他方式)。 好好享受,但我們建議您快速吃它 --- 您永遠不知道 Sasquatch 何時會冒險從樹林中偷走它!

description: Australian natural abalone, naturally dried, preserves the strong and sweet taste of abalone, suitable for stew or braised method.鲍鱼(Haliotis australis)属软体动物门，腹足纲，原始腹足目，鲍鱼科。鲍鱼古代称为“鳆”。因为它一面是壳，另一面是平滑的肉，所以，又被称作“镜面鱼”。鲍鱼壳边缘有一排突出的小孔，所以它还叫“九孔螺”。它常栖于海藻丛生的岩礁上，渔民俗称“趴窝”。其壳向右旋，很像只耳朵，于是也有人叫它“海耳”。鲍鱼壳内紫、绿、白三色相映成珍珠色，所以文人墨客美其名日“千光星”。人们发现食用鲍鱼有明目的作用后，又称它“明目鱼”。鲍鱼壳在中药材中被称为“石决明”。 网鲍：为老身鲍鱼，壳上长有像老树般的年轮，烹熟后平面切开，可看到圆纹如网般，甚为明显，所以称网鲍。 澳洲网鲍外形与日本鲍相近，颜色为砖红色，但边缘珠粒不太规则。干鲍要浸发多天才能煲制，鲍肉吃起来较韧，适合煲汤或做鲍片。 鲍鱼肉质细嫩，味道鲜美，营养十分丰富。鲍肉合蛋白质40%，肝醣33.7%，脂肪0.9%，并含多种维生素和微量元素。从鲍肉中提取的鲍灵素能够较强抑制癌细胞生长，有显著的抗癌效果；鲍肉的提取物还可以促进淋巴球细胞增生，是目前已知增强人体免疫力效果最显著的水产品；而且，鲍鱼属于低胆固醇的食品，不易造成人体胆固醇的上升，维生素E含量丰富，是预防心血管疾病的健康食品。鲍壳还可作为中药“石决明”使用。 干鲍鱼的大小以每斤的头数计算，例如10个头，即每斤有10只鲍鱼，头数越少，鲍鱼便越大只，价钱也越昂贵。质量好的干鲍鱼，外形完好，鲍身肥厚，底板阔，带有香气，个头大。而在灯光下若发现一条红线的就更好。有缺口或裂痕的，形如马蹄的，鲍背凹凸不平、外干内湿、或鲍身呈现黑点的就不应选购。

Packaging:
Our orders are carefully packed using dry ice inside insulated inserts in a corrugated shipping box. Your fish will remain frozen for you to put right in the freezer until you’re ready to eat!

Thawing:
It’s best to thaw seafood overnight in the refrigerator. Place the package on a plate or shallow pan to catch any liquid and allow 8-10 hours (for full fillets).

Never allow seafood to thaw at room temperature or place in water to thaw. Flavor and texture are both lost this way.

About Our Product:
Our King Salmon is wild caught and has a flavor that is unrivaled because our process is simple. We catch and process only our fish. All of our fish is processed and flash frozen within hours of harvest. This keeps the fish fresh and helps maintain the nutrients and flavor that so many of our customers are searching for. Wild Alaskan King Salmon (some times called Chinook Salmon) are a sustainably managed species by the state of Alaska, and many health organizations, included but not limited to, the EPA and FDA, view King Salmon as one of the cleanest of all ocean fish. As a small family fisherman owned operation we believe in one thing: providing you with a product that we are equally as excited to eat. The quality and taste are unsurpassed and the level of freshness can only get better if you join us on the boat! Portion fillets range in size from 8-12 oz. each depending on the size of the fish they are hand cut from. Each piece serves 1-2 people. The 10 lb. box contains 12 to 20 pieces. description: Dry-cured yellowfin tuna Aged in sea salt Premium grade cut from the loin Slice thinly and drizzle with olive oil Add to salads or pasta Size - 7 oz/200 gr Mojama is called the jamón of the sea, after Spain's famous cured ham. To create this traditional cured tuna, a whole yellowfin loin is salted and dry-cured to perfection. The cured mojama has a deep flavor of the sea and is delicious served thinly sliced, or added to salads and pastas. On the Costa de Luz, from Cádiz to Portugal, they carve thin slices and drizzle them with olive oil, to be enjoyed with good bread, roasted almonds and a glass of light, dry wine. Along the coast of Murcia and Alicante in the Mediterranean, people prefer to have their mojama served in small pieces as a garnish for a green salad – in the fashion of bacon bits. You can add wonderful flavor of your sopa de marisco, seafood stew or the broth for your seafood paella by adding shavings of mojama. Mojama originated centuries ago along the southwest coast of Spain in Huelva and Cádiz. The climate along that area of the Costa de la Luz tends to be breezy and dry, perfect for preserving the abundance of tuna caught in the Mediterranean Sea. To cure the tuna, the fishermen used to pack fresh fillets in sea salt, rinse them and then hang them in the sun to dry. The constant light winds in the region were key to assuring that the fillets were thoroughly dry. As they were cured in the sun, the loins shrank and darkened until they were a reddish brown with a subtle flavor. Now our partners at Salazones Garre cure their mojama in pristine drying rooms, following stringent food safety standards. This family company from Murcia recreates the curing conditions used by their forefathers, but with much higher precision, creating a beautiful mojama that is higher quality and a premium consistency.

The History of Angelo Parodi

Angelo Parodi dates to 1888 when the legendary Parodi created  the brand that for over 100 years, has brought to tables all over the world the Italian excellence in tuna and other fish specialties. Fishing Areas, Methods and Protection of Marine Resources and Endangered Species

Angelo Parodi does NOT procure fish sourced from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.  We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction.

description:
HEALTH BENEFITS

Why does our canned Albacore taste different than industrial tuna?

It’s different fish. Our Albacore are young, fatty fish individually line-caught in the cold waters of the North and South Pacific Ocean. They are higher in Omega-3s because they eat rich diets of krill, squid and anchovies, ultimately making them fattier and vastly tastier. Albacores’ whiteness signifies quality: the whiter the Albacore, the fattier their diet.

We solely target Albacore that is 3-5 years old, weighing 11 to 16 pounds. By comparison, conventional canned tuna is fish that are around 15 years old, weighing over 60 pounds.

All of St Jude Tuna is canned locally in the Northwest. The Albacore are hand filleted and hand packed into a BPA-Free can and cooked in their own juices. This process is called cold-pack canning.

What about mercury?

Our young Albacore are under 5 years old which makes them naturally lower in mercury because they are caught in cold water, before they are old enough to migrate to tropical waters. Results from an Oregon State University study indicate that young Albacore are substantially lower in mercury. Our own tests (conducted by Food Quality Labs, in Portland, Oregon) corroborate this.

SUSTAINABILITY

The St. Jude, a 95-foot fishing vessel based in Seattle, Washington, participates exclusively in the troll fishery (individually line caught) for Albacore. This method is rated a “Best Choice” by the Monterey Bay Aquarium Seafood Watch, meaning that the numbers are healthy and bycatch and habitat impacts are minimal.

ABOUT US

The Malley's are a family business based in Seattle. Joe Malley began troll fishing in Sitka, Alaska in 1978.

Presently, Joe and his wife Joyce own the 95-foot fishing vessel St. Jude which trolls solely for Albacore tuna in the North and South Pacific, depending on the season.

description:
The History of Angelo Parodi

Angelo Parodi dates to 1888 when the legendary Parodi created  the brand that for over 100 years, has brought to tables all over the world the Italian excellence in tuna and other fish specialties. A long history that has come down to us thanks to the ability of respecting the secrets of tradition combined with the constant search for progress in processing techniques. Angelo Parodi is the precursor of the modern method of conservation and canning of fish. The perfection of the flavor of the products is guaranteed by a strict quality control, the selection of the finest fish, a wise cutting and cleaning technique and finally by giving the seasoning just the right amount of time. Today Angelo Parodi extends his offering by proposing sardines and mackerel from the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts: products that with their characteristics of excellence make Angelo Parodi a legend among lovers of fish preserves.

 

Fishing Areas, Methods and Protection of Marine Resources and Endangered Species

Angelo Parodi does NOT procure fish sourced from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.  We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction.

description: Ventresca di Tonno Rosso is the belly of the fish - known in Japan as toro. Based in Erice, Conservificio Tre Torri continues to prepare tuna with artisanal methods generations old. These Mediterranean Bluefin Tuna are never frozen and he entire production is done by hand; when the tuna arrives. It is butchered, and the cuts are selected and separated for ventresca, tarantello, and trancio. It is boiled in small batches, cooled, and canned using local Sicilian olive oil and sea salt from Trapani. Uncontrolled fishing has wreaked havoc on the tuna population, and Gustiamo is proud to support a small producer who continues to use tuna fished sustainably, with the traditional net and hook methods. Tre Torri produces a very small quantity of canned tuna - about 88,000 pounds a year - which is the amount some industrial plants process in one day. description: Australian natural abalone, naturally dried, preserves the strong and sweet taste of abalone, suitable for stew or braised method. 鲍鱼(Haliotis australis)属软体动物门，腹足纲，原始腹足目，鲍鱼科。鲍鱼古代称为“鳆”。因为它一面是壳，另一面是平滑的肉，所以，又被称作“镜面鱼”。鲍鱼壳边缘有一排突出的小孔，所以它还叫“九孔螺”。它常栖于海藻丛生的岩礁上，渔民俗称“趴窝”。其壳向右旋，很像只耳朵，于是也有人叫它“海耳”。鲍鱼壳内紫、绿、白三色相映成珍珠色，所以文人墨客美其名日“千光星”。人们发现食用鲍鱼有明目的作用后，又称它“明目鱼”。鲍鱼壳在中药材中被称为“石决明”。 网鲍：为老身鲍鱼，壳上长有像老树般的年轮，烹熟后平面切开，可看到圆纹如网般，甚为明显，所以称网鲍。 澳洲网鲍外形与日本鲍相近，颜色为砖红色，但边缘珠粒不太规则。干鲍要浸发多天才能煲制，鲍肉吃起来较韧，适合煲汤或做鲍片。 鲍鱼肉质细嫩，味道鲜美，营养十分丰富。鲍肉合蛋白质40%，肝醣33.7%，脂肪0.9%，并含多种维生素和微量元素。从鲍肉中提取的鲍灵素能够较强抑制癌细胞生长，有显著的抗癌效果；鲍肉的提取物还可以促进淋巴球细胞增生，是目前已知增强人体免疫力效果最显著的水产品；而且，鲍鱼属于低胆固醇的食品，不易造成人体胆固醇的上升，维生素E含量丰富，是预防心血管疾病的健康食品。鲍壳还可作为中药“石决明”使用。 干鲍鱼的大小以每斤的头数计算，例如10个头，即每斤有10只鲍鱼，头数越少，鲍鱼便越大只，价钱也越昂贵。质量好的干鲍鱼，外形完好，鲍身肥厚，底板阔，带有香气，个头大。而在灯光下若发现一条红线的就更好。有缺口或裂痕的，形如马蹄的，鲍背凹凸不平、外干内湿、或鲍身呈现黑点的就不应选购。

description:
The History of Angelo Parodi dates to 1888 when the legendary Parodi created the brand that for over 100 years, has brought to tables all over the world the Italian excellence in tuna, sardines, mackerel and other fish specialties. A long history that has come down to us thanks to the ability of respecting the secrets of tradition combined with the constant search for progress in processing techniques. Angelo Parodi is the precursor of the modern method of conservation and canning of fish.

The perfection of the flavor of the products is guaranteed by a strict quality control, the selection of the finest fish, a wise cutting and cleaning technique and, finally by giving the seasoning just the right amount of time.

Today Angelo Parodi extends his offering by proposing sardines and mackerel from the Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts: products that with their characteristics of excellence make Angelo Parodi a legend among lovers of fish preserves.

Fishing areas and methods

Angelo Parodi does not fish products coming from the marine reserves of the Pacific or from other reserves and protected areas identified by the coastal states. In the procurement processes we consider the use of selective and safe fishing methods and equipment as fundamental to minimizing the incidental catches of immature fish and other species. We consider the protection of the marine environment a priority, so that the natural heritage and biodiversity of the natural waters are preserved.

Protection of marine resources and endangered species

We encourage the presence of independent international observers on board our suppliers' ships and we do not purchase species deemed at risk of extinction. We only deal with suppliers who promote measures to reduce waste and discharges into the sea and encourage compliance with fishing bans.

독특한 맛과 우수한 품질 덕분에 Rio Mare Tuna는 언제나 이탈리아에서 참치를 위한 최고의 선택입니다. 리오 마레는 가장 안목 있는 미각도 만족시킵니다.
특징
참치의 독특한 핑크 색상과 프리미엄 품질은 리오 마레 참치의 핵심 강점입니다. 높은 품질은 참치 필레를 꼼꼼하게 선택하고 공급망 전반에 걸쳐 엄격한 제어가 이루어졌습니다.
리오 마레 참치는 고급 올리브 오일과 바다 소금으로 통조림됩니다. 맛있고 영양이 풍부한 메인 코스로 훌륭할 뿐만 아니라 군침 도는 레시피를 만드는 완벽한 재료이기도 합니다. 참치는 건강하고 균형 잡힌 식단의 중요한 부분입니다. 100g에는 필수 아미노산이 풍부한 단백질 25g과 비타민과 인이 포함되어 있습니다. 리오 마레 통조림 참치는 10% 미만의 지방과 탄수화물을 함유하지 않아 100~190 칼로리 사이의 총 칼로리 섭취량을 제공합니다.

description:
This ingredient may seem a bit unusual, but it is a traditional preparation from southern Italy. This distillate is a fish sauce extracted from cured anchovies. Each batch takes five months to produce.

Ittica Alimentare Salerno (IASA) uses only premium anchovies harvested in the Mediterranean. IASA is located in the small village of Cetara, south of Naples, on the Amalfi coast. They have been processing freshly caught anchovies since 1969.

One of the treasured ingredients of the region, Colatura di Alici, has roots that date back to ancient Rome. Until recently this ingredient was rarely found in the United States. Colatura di Alici is recognized and protected by Slow Food.

Traditional suggestions include using a small splash of colatura with browned garlic, chili flakes, extra virgin olive oil, parsley, and toasted breadcrumbs on pasta. Another lovely pasta dish is orecchiette with cauliflower, garlic, chilies, raisins and pine nuts and a hint of colatura. Also a favorite with dishes such as steamed broccoli, braised sea bass, or substituted for anchovies in Caesar salad. Always start with a small splash!

description:
FAQ's

What Do You Feed Your Salmon?

Our goal is to provide a long-term sustainable diet that meets all the nutritional requirements of King Salmon. The feed carries Certificates of Analysis from registered laboratories, is certified GMO-free and BSE-free, and all ingredients are fully traceable. The feed consists of fish meal (sourced from sustainable fisheries), fish oil, animal protein and oil, vegetable protein meals, wheat/starch, vitamins, and minerals including the antioxidant Astaxanthin.

Do You Dye Your Salmon?

No. Our salmon feed contains Astaxanthin which is naturally found in Algae and krill and is an essential micro-nutrient for salmon. It’s so important to the salmon that they have the capacity to store the Astaxanthin in their muscle tissue because that is what makes them pink. Astaxanthin is a powerful antioxidant that is also found in other foods including dietary supplements.

Is Your Environment Clean?

Throughout their life, our salmon experience arguably the cleanest rearing environment found anywhere in the world. As smolt, they are nurtured in the safe sanctuaries of our pure mountain fed streams before being transferred to sea farms located in the remote, crystal clear sea waters of the Marlborough Sounds.

description:
"

FAQ's

What Do You Feed Your Salmon?

Our goal is to provide a long-term sustainable diet that meets all the nutritional requirements of King Salmon. The feed carries Certificates of Analysis from registered laboratories, is certified GMO-free and BSE-free, and all ingredients are fully traceable. The feed consists of fish meal (sourced from sustainable fisheries), fish oil, animal protein and oil, vegetable protein meals, wheat/starch, vitamins, and minerals including the antioxidant Astaxanthin.

Do You Dye Your Salmon?

No. Our salmon feed contains Astaxanthin which is naturally found in Algae and krill and is an essential micro-nutrient for salmon. It’s so important to the salmon that they have the capacity to store the Astaxanthin in their muscle tissue because that is what makes them pink. Astaxanthin is a powerful antioxidant that is also found in other foods including dietary supplements.

Is Your Environment Clean?

Throughout their life, our salmon experience arguably the cleanest rearing environment found anywhere in the world. As smolt, they are nurtured in the safe sanctuaries of our pure mountain fed streams before being transferred to sea farms located in the remote, crystal clear sea waters of the Marlborough Sounds.

There are important things you must know to desalt salt fish properly. All salt fish needs to be properly soaked to extract the excess salt. So before cooking it, you’ll need to desalt it. How to soak cod is similar, soaking salt fish in general follows the same principals.

    Desalt salt fish the easy way!

    A few tips you will need to correctly desalt your salt fish are:
    • A bowl or recipiente, big enough for the fish cutlets and as much water as possible.
    • Using a small bowl or recipiente will slow down desalting, so choose the correct size;
    • Ice bottle or very cold water (+2ºC)
    • It can take up to 3 days to desalt, depending on the thickness of the cutlet. So plan ahead to make sure your salt fish is ready to cook when you need it.
    • The soaking process will basically extract the salt from the fish. The water absorbes the salt, however the saturation point of water is very low. Therefore several water changes are required to insure that desalting is made properly.
    • Wash the excess salt from the cutlets before soaking.
    • Place them at the bottom of the bowl or recipiente with skin facing up.
    • Fill with cold water, and place the ice bottles to maintain the cold water temperature.
    • If possible place the bowl or recipiente in the refrigerator.
    • Soaking salt fish in warm water will create an odor that will tag along the fish forever. It’s not spoiled but the odor may be intense and unpleasant.

bullet_point: [Wild-Caught Natural Sardines – Sustainably harvested off the coast of Spain and packed in high-quality olive oil our sardine fillets offer rich, natural bold flavors., Exceptional Taste and Texture – A more authentic canned sardines experience our small fish have the skin on and bone in to create a more enjoyable meal or snack., Versatile Meal Addition – Enjoy them fresh out of the can or add them to tapas, tossed veggies, pasta, or with a touch of lemon to create an original flavor blend., Protein-Rich Snack – These wild caught sardines are packed with proteins, vitamins, Omega 3 fish oils, and other essential ingredients that support your daily diet., Gluten Free and Non-GMO – Backed by purity and freshness you can trust, we carefully pack each can to ensure they arrive ready to eat and free of additives.]
description:
Spain is a treasure-trove of delicious meals and unique flavors, but one of our most versatile and exciting additions are Matiz Sardines. Caught fresh off the coast of Galicia and hand-packed in premium Spanish olive oil, our small sardine fish make a wonderful addition to your favorite pastas, vegetable medleys, or other appetizers. In fact, they can be enjoyed as-is, added to French breads with sliced avocado and lemon, or smeared with a garlic aioli to create a truly unforgettable taste.

Smaller, Bite-Sized Sardines
Our sardines are smaller in size to create a fresher, more delicious taste but also to make them easier to add to breads, crackers, or other fun appetizers.
Authentic Texture and Taste
We’ve left the skin on and the bones in to create a more original Spanish flavoring in every bite and to ensure you’re getting the freshest sardines possible.
Sustainably Harvested Purity
Harvested off the coast of Galacia which is known for its exceptional seafoods, we maintain traditional methods of sourcing our sardines to help maintain the surrounding sea life and support local fisherman. We use artisan fishing methods and master cannery methods to retain the highest-quality ingredients with the moistest, most tender fish possible.
Made Fresh and Ready to Eat
Matiz sardines are carefully sourced and packed fresh and delicious so when they arrive at your doorstep, they’re ready to be enjoyed as is. This means you can take them to work as snacks, enjoy them at a picnic, or use them as an addition to your favorite afternoon appetizers with friends.
True Culinary Versatility
Sardines make a great addition to a variety of healthy dishes and pair well with things like sour cream, creme fraiche, fresh herbs, lemon and smoked pimento.
Heart Healthy Snack
These small fish are also packed with vitamins, minerals, and proteins that are good for you and help support a healthy diet. Non-GMO and gluten free.

description:
FAQ's

What Do You Feed Your Salmon?

Our goal is to provide a long-term sustainable diet that meets all the nutritional requirements of King Salmon. The feed carries Certificates of Analysis from registered laboratories, is certified GMO-free and BSE-free, and all ingredients are fully traceable. The feed consists of fish meal (sourced from sustainable fisheries), fish oil, animal protein and oil, vegetable protein meals, wheat/starch, vitamins, and minerals including the antioxidant Astaxanthin.

Do You Dye Your Salmon?

No. Our salmon feed contains Astaxanthin which is naturally found in Algae and krill and is an essential micro-nutrient for salmon. It’s so important to the salmon that they have the capacity to store the Astaxanthin in their muscle tissue because that is what makes them pink. Astaxanthin is a powerful antioxidant that is also found in other foods including dietary supplements.

Is Your Environment Clean?

Throughout their life, our salmon experience arguably the cleanest rearing environment found anywhere in the world. As smolt, they are nurtured in the safe sanctuaries of our pure mountain fed streams before being transferred to sea farms located in the remote, crystal clear sea waters of the Marlborough Sounds.

description:
Once a frozen fillet is completely thawed, it can be re-frozen though we do not recommend it, as taste and quality may begin to suffer. No fillet should be re-frozen if it has been thawed 2 days or longer.

The best way to thaw your wild salmon dinner fillet is to leave it in the refrigerator overnight (in its pouch), allowing at least 8-10 hours. Trying to rush the process by thawing at room temperature or placing the frozen pouch in warm water is definitely NOT recommended, as it can cause the salmon to lose flavor and texture. If you must thaw your salmon quickly, place the frozen pouch in a bowl of cool water for 30-45 minutes, and then continue thawing in refrigerator.

TO BAKE: Pre-heat oven to 275°F. Place salmon fillet skin side down on a cookie sheet brushed with olive oil, and bake for approximately 20 minutes. Do not flip salmon fillet.

TO GRILL: Brush grill with olive oil PRIOR to heating. Once the grill is medium-hot (you should be able to hold your hand 6 inches above the grill for 5 seconds), brush the top of each salmon fillet with olive oil, and place on grill skin side up. Grill fillet until sides begin to turn opaque. Flip once, and continue grilling until fully cooked.

TO BROIL: Place salmon fillet skin side down on a broiler pan brushed with olive oil, and place on oven’s middle rack. Generally broil about 10 minutes or so, though keep watching to avoid overcooking. Do not flip salmon fillet.

description:
The London Cure smoked Scottish salmon is what H. Forman & Son is known for. Formans hand prepares every side of salmon, from the filleting to the rope hanging to the pin-bone removal to the hand carving. There's no sugar, no nitrites, no added coloring and no wet brine. You will receive the finest smoked Scottish salmon direct to your door.

Our Story

When Harry (Aaron) Forman arrived in London’s East End from Russia at the beginning of the last century he pursued the trade he knew best – curing fish; in particular, the salmon he imported in barrels of brine from the Baltic. It wasn’t long, however, before he discovered a rich source of fresh wild salmon much closer to home: Scotland.

Inspired by the exceptional quality of fresh Scottish salmon, Harry developed a cure that complemented its unrivalled flavour. The deliciously mild London Cure was born and soon it was the talk of reputable establishments around the capital such as Wilton's restaurant which we have supplied for over 90 years with our genuine wild smoked Scottish salmon.

A century later H. Forman & Son remains a family concern, the last of the original London smokeries, with Lance Forman, Harry’s great grandson, flying the flag for the famous London Cure. Remaining faithful to principles established in 1905 – the freshest salmon, a little salt, just the right amount of oak smoke – he is upholding traditional values and skills that would otherwise have died out long ago, along with one of gastronomy’s finest foods: H. Forman & Son’s Genuine Wild Smoked Scottish Salmon.

title: Nardin Bonito del Norte Tuna Loin (15.2 Ounces)
bullet_point: [9.8 oz jar, Line caught, dolphin friendly, Hand prepared, Packed in olive oil]
description: No country takes jarred tuna more seriously than Spain. Each step in the process ensures quality: line caught tuna, prepared by hand, is packed in olive oil. The result is the most tender, flavorful and moist tuna you have ever tried. One secret is in the preparation. Fresh Bonito del Norte is carefully cooked in sea water, then the tuna loins are hand cut and placed in glass jars. They are then topped off with olive oil, which preserves the tender flaky texture of the tuna. During the fishing season the Nardin family selects the best Bonito del Norte tuna from each morning's catch and prepares it that day fresh at their small facility in the Basque country. They never use frozen fish, another reason why theirs is the finest tuna in Spain. Bonito del Norte is a small tuna that migrates from the Atlantic to the rich, cool seas north of Spain every year. There they linger and fatten up on the plentiful smaller fish. This is the moment when the tuna is ripe for harvest. The Spanish fishing boats catch the tuna by hand with fishing poles - never with nets or long lines. This preserves the quality of the fish, which would otherwise be stressed by other harvesting methods. We invite you to try the very best tuna in the world. One of our favorite ways to serve Bonito del Norte is to toast rounds of french bread, place a sweet piquillo pepper on top of each, then a piece of tuna. Broil them for a minute or two until warm. Que maravilla!

Our Story

When Harry (Aaron) Forman arrived in London’s East End from Russia at the beginning of the last century he pursued the trade he knew best – curing fish; in particular, the salmon he imported in barrels of brine from the Baltic. It wasn’t long, however, before he discovered a rich source of fresh wild salmon much closer to home: Scotland.

Inspired by the exceptional quality of fresh Scottish salmon, Harry developed a cure that complemented its unrivalled flavour. The deliciously mild London Cure was born and soon it was the talk of reputable establishments around the capital such as Wilton's restaurant which we have supplied for over 90 years with our genuine wild smoked Scottish salmon.

A century later H. Forman & Son remains a family concern, the last of the original London smokeries, with Lance Forman, Harry’s great grandson, flying the flag for the famous London Cure. Remaining faithful to principles established in 1905 – the freshest salmon, a little salt, just the right amount of oak smoke – he is upholding traditional values and skills that would otherwise have died out long ago, along with one of gastronomy’s finest foods: H. Forman & Son’s Genuine Wild Smoked Scottish Salmon.
